problems.problem: The painted wall shape is a generic round-topped arch (approx x180-1030, y240-990) with straight vertical sides, not the enlarged contour-bottle curve the concept requires; the real bottle (bbox 450-630 x, 561-1211 y) is far narrower than the arch, so the promised 'recognition event' - real contour filling the lower half of its own giant silhouette - never happens and the alignment seam is absent.
problems.root_cause: background.prompt asked the generator for a contour silhouette but the generated scenery returned an arch niche; no deterministic shape primitive was used to guarantee the contour.
problems.repair_strategy: Replace the generated contour with the bounded product_silhouette primitive derived from the original alpha, sized so the real bottle fills its lower portion, and empty the prompt of contour language so only wall/floor material and light regenerate.

problems.problem: The generated wall carries a lateral gradient and vignette that darken toward center-right behind the headline zone; the measured ink on that mid-value grey reads muddy rather than crisp luxury ink, and the uneven wall contradicts the declared even, hotspot-free diffuse light.
problems.root_cause: Generated wall tonality drifted darker than the palette anchor #C9C6C0 while ink stayed #23201C at low local contrast.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate with an explicitly light, even mineral-grey wall value and lift title/subtitle ink toward the palette charcoal only where the wall stays light; keep diffuse frontal-overhead illumination wording without equipment names.

problems.problem: Product height ratio is 0.4514 (valid per fresh_concept_size_policy) but against the oversized arch the bottle reads small and recessive; the hero event of the campaign sits at under half canvas height while a non-identifying arch dominates the frame.
problems.root_cause: Silhouette primitive was never bounded to the product aspect, so scenic mass outweighs the packshot.
problems.repair_strategy: Enlarge product to ~0.55 height ratio (center y recomputed from target base) and bind the silhouette primitive to the same contour so scale contrast becomes intentional instead of accidental.

changes.value: Matte mineral grey painted studio wall in a light even value close to pale warm grey, meeting a continuous fine-ground cement floor at a low horizon, soft diffuse frontal overhead illumination, completely even low contrast across the wall, no gradient vignette, no painted shapes, no visible equipment

logo_correct.evidence: Bottom-left layer renders the authorized string 'Coca-Cola' exactly, uncropped at bbox 76,1361-232,1384, and the bottle's own red band carries the untouched white script wordmark.

shape_preserved.evidence: Rendered bottle bbox 450,561-630,1211 matches the source contour bottle proportion (width/height ~0.28 vs source ~0.28); crown cap, shoulder curve and waist flutes identical to image 2.

grounding_correct.evidence: Contact detail crop 370,1071-710,1321 shows the glass base heel darkened into a soft contact shadow seam directly beneath the base at y=1211 with shadow offset_y=0; no floating gap.

edges_clean.evidence: Cutout edges against wall and floor show no halo or fringe in the enlarged crop; droplets and glass rim remain crisp.

lighting_consistent.evidence: Narrow vertical speculars on shoulders and sides plus even low-contrast body match the declared soft diffuse front/above light; floor shadow is a single soft contact layer with no competing cast direction.

text_uncropped.evidence: Title bbox 76,108-699,191, subtitle 76,223-380,253 and logo 76,1361-232,1384 all sit fully inside the 1080x1440 canvas.

text_collision_free.evidence: geometry.text_product_overlap reports false for title, subtitle and logo; no layer intersects the product bbox on both axes.

fonts_present.evidence: Spec fonts msyh.ttc for Chinese copy and BASKVILL.TTF for the Latin logo are both in the installed approved list and render with correct glyphs.

brand_spelling_correct.evidence: 'Coca-Cola' hyphenation and capitalization correct in the corner lockup; label band reads Coca-Cola with ORIGINAL TASTE as observed on source.

copy_concept_specific.evidence: Title 'the curve recognized at a glance' and subtitle 'no need to read the name, the contour answers' state this poster's shape-recognition proposition and could not be swapped onto another campaign.

visual_memory_visible.evidence: The intended memorable event - real bottle visually filling the lower half of its own giant painted contour - is absent; the wall shows a generic arch whose straight sides and wide dome never coincide with the bottle silhouette at any point.

commercial_gate.basis: visual-model evidence plus deterministic geometry; not independent human commercial certification
